#3000-60445 DECLARATIONOFDEEDRESTRICTIONANDMAINTENANCE DECLARATION made this -day of July, 2013 by SD Flushing LLC, having its . principal office at c/o Storage Deluxe, 26 West 17th Street, Suite 801, New York, NY 10011 (hereinafter referred to as "Declarant"). WHEREAS, theDECLARANTis the above owner of certain real property situated in the Borough of Queens,County of Queens and State of NewYork,known and designated as Block 5066, lot 255,the “Premises", as shown.on the tax map of the City of New York for the County of Queens; and WHEREAS, the DECLARANT proposes to develop the 2.268 acre site by constructing two (2) buildings ("Buildings") and associated site and street infrastructure improvements in accordance with the plans filed with The Department of Environmental Protection ("NYCDEP") under permit application number SCQ 018/13 and New York City Department of Buildings ("NYD0B") underpermit number 420820721; and WHEREAS, the Buildings are to be served by a common area (the “Common Area") common storm and sanitary sewer disposal systems including internal drains and storm water detention/retention facilities, serving more than one of the buildings ("Common Facilities") under the NYCDEP site connection proposal application number SCQ 018/13; WHEREAS,the Common Areais shown in the attached diagrammatic sketch entitled Exhibit "A" and is more particularly described on Exhibit B attached hereto. WHEREAS,the City of NewYorkDepartment of Buildings and the:NYCDEP requires as a condition precedent to the issuance of the aforesaid permit, a firm commitment by the Declarant establishing said Common Areas as well as providing for the maintenance and repair of the internal sanitary and storm water systems, storm water detention/retention facilities, and of the restrictions therefore, as.hereinafter set forth. NOW, THEREFORE,it is agreed as follows: 1. The Declarant, and its successors and assigns covenant that the Premises and Buildings may not be subdivided and shall be held in single ownership unless and until Declaration of Covenants, Restrictions, Easements, Charges and Liens is recorded against the Premises provided this is accomplished in accordance with applicable laws, rules and regulations in effect at that time.  The Declarant, its successor and assigns, does hereby establish and create for the benefit of the lawful occupants of the Buildings, future owners of the lots, the following easement, licenses, rights and privileges within the above described Common Area:

① Right-of-Way for ingress and egress by vehicles or pedestrians over the Common Area for purposes ancillary to the Premises and subject to any limitations and restriction set forth in any leases entered into by any occupants with the Declarant. (i) Right. to connect with, maintain and make use of public or private utility lines, water mains, wires, pipes, conduits, internal ·sanitary and storm drains and storm water detention/retention facilities which.may befrom time to time be in or along the CommonArea. 3.  The Declarant, its successor and assigns agree to construct, maintain and keep in good repair the Common·Facilities. 4. The Declarant, its successors or assigns agree that the Common Facilities shall forever be kept free and clear of any and all obstructions to the drainage flow pattern as set forth in the aforesaid site connection proposal. The Declarant, its successors or assigns agree that the Common Facilities shall not be 6. The Declarant agrees that any deed for conveyance by, for or on behalf of the Declarant of the properties herein above described shall contain the terms, conditions and obligations stated herein above described shali be subject to the terms, conditions.and obligations stated herein and.provisions shall be made to obligate the Declarant heirs, successors and assigns'to construct, inspect repair, replace or otherwise maintain the aforesaid Common.Facilities. 7. The parties hereto, their successors and assigns shall, at all times, indemnify and hold harmless the City of New York against any claims which may result from the construction, operation,maintenance,inspection,malfunction,repair or replacement of the aforementioned drainage'systems and site connections. 8. This agreement may not be amended, terminated or modified without the prior written consent of the NewYork City Department of Buildings and the NYCDEP.Notwithstanding the foregoing, this Declaration shall automatically be terminated upon the filing of the Declaration of . Covenants, Restrictions, Easements, Charges.and Liens against the Premises. 9. Failure to comply with the terms of this declaration may result in the revocation of a permit or Certificate of Occupancy. FURTHERMORE, this Declaration shall be a covenant running, with the land, in perpetuity and shall be binding upon the grantees, heirs, assigns and successors of the Declarant, and shall remain in full force and effect until such time as Declaration of Covenants, Restrictions, Easements, Charges and Liens is recorded against the Premises
